'''March 2001 Elizabethton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Callandor Cards and Collectibles, Elizabethton, Tennessee on 17 March 2001. [[Randy Koruschak]] won it. It is known from Randy Koruschak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1908">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-elizabethton-tennessee-3-17-01d1908/ elizabethton-tennessee-3-17-01], DeckTech (Randy "the tall guy" Koruschak, 17 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-elizabethton-tennessee-3-17-01d1908/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Callandor Cards and Collectibles, Elizabethton, Tennessee
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Randy Koruschak]]
